subject: Re: Kickoff: memorization audit for our LMs — status + privacy process
body:
Hi Priya, Santiago,

Status:

- Methodology reproduced in early March on the released prompt set; our extraction curves show the same log-linear shape in context length (memorization roughly doubles going from 50 to 200 prompt tokens on the largest public model we tested).
- Vera's duplication pipeline finished Apr 27 — slightly late, but the counts are validated. Notable: 0.9% of our corpus appears 10+ times, and those examples are exactly where early spot-checks show verbatim continuations.

Process risk: Kofi (cc'd) points out the audit outputs will themselves contain memorized training text, so the readout artifacts need privacy review, and that SLA is 2-3 weeks. Counting back from the Jun 19 readout, the sweep outputs must be locked and submitted by May 29 — before the June reservation week produces the final numbers. Proposal: submit the report template + March sample outputs for review now, then the June numbers drop into an approved format. Kofi's tentatively ok with this, confirming this week.

Nikhil
